packet.question: Did Amazon's FY2024 10-K attribute AWS sales growth to higher pricing rather than customer usage? Explain the stated direction of the pricing effect.

answer.answer: Increased customer usage was the primary AWS growth driver, and higher prices were another positive growth driver.

claims.text: Increased customer usage was the primary AWS growth driver, and higher prices were another positive growth driver.

Different restated values, segments, periods or metrics are not interchangeable. Narrative/attribution facets retain their named fiscal-year disclosure scope.
